objective_success_bonus.condition: Both legs contact (state[6]==1 and state[7]==1) and |x|<0.15 and |y|<0.15 and |vy|<0.5

progress_bonus.condition: First time distance<0.5 and (leg1==1 or leg2==1)

approach_bonus.condition: First time distance<0.15 and (leg1==1 or leg2==1)

touchdown_stability_bonus.condition: leg1==1 and leg2==1 and abs(vy)<0.5 and abs(vx)<0.5 and abs(angle)<0.2 and distance<0.04
